name: Portable JSON Library — Classification Schema

mesh_resolution.problem_identified: Original schema said Ace = Spade universally. This collapses suit (identity) into state (rank). A portable JSON should not change suit when archived — it is Diamond by nature, and Diamond it stays.

resolution.suit: PERMANENT — identity of the document's nature, does not change through lifecycle
resolution.rank: TRANSIENT — lifecycle state, changes as document is processed
resolution.spade_of_aces: VAULT REGISTER — the catalog of all vaulted documents regardless of their own suit. A document is LISTED IN the Spade of Aces; it does not BECOME a Spade Ace.
resolution.diamond_of_aces: ARCHIVED DOCUMENT — a Diamond-suit document that has completed its lifecycle and been vaulted. Its suit (Diamond) is preserved. Its rank becomes Ace. Its Spade of Aces entry is its catalog record.

diamond.nature: Conversation heritage — living knowledge, portable sessions, the intellectual thread across time
diamond.documents: Portable JSONs, session carriers, conversation exports
diamond.lifecycle: Diamond Jack → Diamond Ace (simple: working → archived)
diamond.vault_registration: Listed in Spade of Aces catalog on becoming Ace

spade.nature: Transformation track — nullification, carbonization, vault operations
spade.documents: MOAVs, nullified versions, carbonite copies, vault registers
spade.lifecycle: Nine → Ten → Jack → King → Queen → Ace (full pinochle progression)
spade.vault_registration: The Spade of Aces IS the vault register for all suits

club.nature: Operations — contributor pipeline, PR flow, domos management
club.documents: Branch trackers, PR carriers, contributor onboarding
club.lifecycle: TBD — operational documents have their own rhythm
club.vault_registration: Listed in Spade of Aces on archival

diamond_jack.state: active — working portable JSON, current session or recent carrier
diamond_jack.authority: carries King's authority within the Diamond track
diamond_jack.description: The portable JSON in active use. Being referenced, continued from, or handed off. Highest working state for Diamond-suit documents.
diamond_jack.transition_to: Diamond Ace (on archival into PJL volume)

diamond_ace.state: archived — vaulted in PJL, permanent heritage record
diamond_ace.description: The portable JSON in its resting state. Assigned a Dewey number. Listed in Spade of Aces catalog. Preserved as volume entry in PJL.
diamond_ace.vault_catalog_entry: Spade of Aces — the register records its Dewey address, prima_clock, volume, and a brief description

dewey_system.description: Portable JSON Library classification. Extends Dewey Decimal with superposition and custom namespaces. The Dewey number is an IDENTITY ASPECT — it stays with the document through all state changes.

superposition.concept: A document exists in multiple classification spaces simultaneously. The primary address is its identity. Secondary addresses are other spaces it inhabits. 'Observation' (accessing for a specific purpose) collapses the superposition to the relevant address.

secondary_namespaces.SAX: Spade Ace eXtension — vault register reference (the catalog entry)
secondary_namespaces.DAX: Diamond Ace eXtension — heritage collection cross-reference
secondary_namespaces.CAX: Concept Ace eXtension — thematic cross-reference when document touches a named concept

custom_extensions.note: Standard Dewey covers 000-999. PJL extends with named namespaces beyond the numeric space.

dewey_christening.description: The moment a document receives its Dewey number. This is a formal interaction — a naming ceremony. The document is recognized, located in knowledge space, and given an identity that travels with it forever.
dewey_christening.trigger: Document graduating from atelier OR entering a PJL volume for the first time
dewey_christening.output: Dewey number stamped in document + entry in volume index + SAX catalog record created

volumes.structure: PJL volumes are named by era, not just numbered. The number provides order; the name provides meaning.

vol_000.name: Genesis
vol_000.description: Before the system had a name. The earliest portable JSONs — raw session heritage from before formalized processes.

spade_of_aces_catalog.description: The vault register. All Diamond Aces, Spade Aces, Club Aces — any document reaching Ace rank is listed here. The catalog holds the address, not the content.
spade_of_aces_catalog.status: pending creation — populates as first Diamond Aces are christened
